phase: Phase 2: Reading Advantage Critical Security and XP Idempotency

type_check_verified.note: reading-advantage full check-types OOMs on this hardware (pre-existing 1.7GB V8 limit); domain+api type-check passes cleanly

findings.title: XP idempotency cross-process gap: acquireActivitySlot returns isPrimary=true from catch-path
findings.description: When two separate Node.js processes race on the same (userId, activityType, targetId), the in-memory Map lock does not help (each process has its own Map). Process B's db.insert(userActivity) fails due to the user_activity_type_target_unique constraint, the catch block fires, the function falls through to SELECT, and returns isPrimary: true. Back in postActivityLog, isPrimaryRequest=true skips the hasExistingXpLog check, so Process B inserts a duplicate xp_logs row. The xp_logs table has no unique constraint on activityId to prevent this. Within a single process, the Map lock correctly serializes and prevents duplicates (proven by test). The DB constraint prevents duplicate user_activity rows across instances, but the XP log insertion path is not protected.
findings.evidence: acquireActivitySlot at user-controller.ts:71-73 always returns isPrimary:true for the 'work' runner. The catch block at line 50-52 sets activityId=null then falls through to SELECT, but isPrimary remains true. The shouldInsertXpLog guard at line 368-373 only checks isPrimaryRequest (not hasExistingXpLog when isPrimary=true). xpLogs schema in analytics.ts:8-18 has no unique constraint on activityId.
mitigating_factors: The in-memory Map lock correctly prevents duplicates within a single process (proven by test)
The user_activity_type_target_unique constraint exists in schema/progress.ts:24 and migration 0013
The test validates single-process concurrency behavior which is the common deployment case
The plan explicitly describes the Map as the 'equivalent domain guard' the spec allows
findings.fix_recommended: Add a unique constraint on xp_logs(userId, activityType) or xp_logs(activityId) so the DB prevents duplicate XP awards across instances. Alternatively, change acquireActivitySlot to return isPrimary=false when the insert fails and the fallback SELECT succeeds.

findings.title: Inline authorization pattern duplicated across deleteClassroom and patchClassroomUnenroll
findings.description: The isOwner/isSystem/isSameSchoolAdmin authorization logic is copy-pasted inline in both deleteClassroom and patchClassroomUnenroll rather than extracted into a shared helper. The uncommitted changes from another agent already address this by extracting canModifyClassroom(). Not blocking since both instances are correct and this is being addressed.
findings.evidence: classroom-controller.ts committed at d40a189e has identical authorization blocks at ~line 906 and ~line 1018
findings.fix_status: Already addressed in uncommitted working tree by another agent (canModifyClassroom helper)

findings.title: deleteUser allows self-delete by any authenticated user
findings.description: The deleteUser authorization check allows isSelfDelete (user.id === id), meaning any authenticated student can delete their own account without admin approval. This may be intentional but is worth documenting as a design decision. The test doesn't exercise this path.
findings.evidence: user-controller.ts:1290-1292: const isSelfDelete = user.id === id; if (!isSystem && !isSameSchoolAdmin && !isSelfDelete)

classroom_ownership_check.detail: Uses getCurrentUser() (server-side session), not frontend-trusted id. Compares classroom.schoolId (from DB) with user.schoolId (from session). Cross-school teacher correctly gets 403. SYSTEM role bypasses. Same-school ADMIN allowed.

xp_idempotency.detail: DB unique constraint exists (progress.ts:24, migration 0013). In-memory Map lock correctly serializes within a single process. Test proves this. Cross-process gap exists (see F1) but DB constraint prevents duplicate activity rows.

audit_recorder.detail: recordAuditEventSafe lazily imports @reading-advantage/auth, caches the function, logs warnings/errors on failure. Does not silently swallow - logs console.warn when unavailable and console.error on call failure. Audit failures do not block destructive ops (intentional resilience design).

level_test_contract.detail: assessmentSchema requires level, sublevel, explanation, strengths[], improvements[], nextSteps (all z.string().min(1) or z.array). validateAssessment handles code-fenced and bare JSON. forceAssessment=true with invalid JSON returns 400. forceAssessment=false omits assessment field (not null).

content_quality_gate.detail: cefrLevelGap uses correct 6-level ladder (A1-C2). Rejects when gap > 1 (cefrLevelGap > 1). C2→A1 gap is 5, correctly rejected. B1→A1 gap is 1, correctly allowed. Article insert happens AFTER the gate check.

system_key_guard.detail: assertSystemAccess checks process.env.ACCESS_KEY against Access-Key header. Returns 401 when env var missing or header mismatch. Applied to generateQueue, refreshAIInsightsAutomated, refreshMaterializedViewsAutomated.

submitRating_auth.detail: Now calls getCurrentUser() and rejects unauthenticated callers with {success: false, error: 'Unauthorized'}. Also checks sessionUser.id !== userId to prevent IDOR.

architecture_review.business_logic_in_domain: Authorization logic is in controllers (existing pattern). Not in components or route handlers.
architecture_review.server_actions_no_fabricated_sessions: submitRating uses getCurrentUser() from real session. No fabricated sessions.
architecture_review.assertCan_pattern: Authorization uses inline isOwner/isSystem/isSameSchoolAdmin (acceptable for Wave 1 representative slice; assertCan propagation is owner-wave work).
architecture_review.tenant_db_compliance: Classroom and user queries use db from @reading-advantage/db. schoolId comparison uses server-side data only.

A3_digit_only_count.detail: All tests use labeled counts: xpLogInsertCount, forbiddenCount, auditCallCount, unauthenticatedAcceptedEndpointCount, offLevelContentRejectedCount. No bare-digit matching.

A4_vacuous_pass.detail: Concurrency test guards with expect(responses.length).toBe(concurrentRequests) (line 174). Audit tests guard with expect(auditCallCount).toBeGreaterThan(0). Auth boundary test reports named endpoints that accepted unauthenticated calls.

A5_false_claim_text.detail: Plan claims '26/26 tests pass, 6/6 suites pass'. Verified: test command exits 0 with exactly 6/6 suites and 26/26 tests. Plan text matches reality.

working_tree_notes: Uncommitted changes exist from another agent (patchClassroomEnroll auth, canModifyClassroom extraction, timing-safe system-key comparison). These are NOT part of Phase 2 committed review scope. The committed HEAD passes all tests cleanly.
handoff: No blocking findings requiring fix commit. F1 (cross-process XP gap) is medium severity and should be tracked for a follow-up wave. All Phase 2 Green tests pass, anti-patterns clear, plan claims verified.
